title: Chinese Civil War (1945–1949)
key_facts: Resumed conflict between the Chinese Communist Party (CCP) and the Nationalists (KMT) after WWII
CCP victory led to the founding of the People’s Republic of China in 1949; KMT retreated to Taiwan
Major Cold War realignment in Asia
causes: Unresolved ideological and political rivalry between CCP and KMT
Power vacuum and rearmament after the Japanese surrender
Foreign support dynamics within emerging Cold War
outcome: Establishment of the PRC and continued Republic of China governance in Taiwan
Shifted Cold War balance in East Asia
impacts: Influenced the outbreak and dynamics of the Korean War
Set the stage for PRC–US relations and regional conflicts
